8 Transformation Priorities

Priority 1

Accurate Mass Appraisal

Achieving 98% accuracy in automated property valuations for council tax and business rates, reducing manual intervention by 60%.

Priority 2

Efficient Appeals Process

Reducing the average time for valuation appeals by 40% through AI-assisted case management and evidence review.

Priority 3

Enhanced Data Integration

Integrating 90% of disparate property data sources into a unified AI platform for comprehensive analysis.

Priority 4

Proactive Fraud Detection

Identifying 25% more instances of fraudulent property claims or valuation discrepancies using advanced AI analytics.

Priority 5

Transparent Valuation Models

Implementing explainable AI (XAI) for all valuation models, ensuring transparency and public trust.

Priority 6

Robust Data Protection

Achieving ISO/IEC 27001 certification for all systems handling property and personal valuation data.

Priority 7

Streamlined Customer Queries

Resolving 85% of routine valuation queries through AI-powered chatbots and self-service portals.

Priority 8

Sustainable Valuation Practices

Incorporating climate risk and energy efficiency data into valuation models, supporting green initiatives.
